The correction adds a debit of 18.00 to 5300 Facilities and a credit of 18.00 to 2000 AP control. This leaves the journal group balanced, and the original lines plus the correction net to 1,950.77 on each side. Period 12 is open, so the lines go there. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate invoice finding.
